what: A big circular window straddling a section boundary (starting at 200~600vw wide, radius half the width) is tied to scroll and grows into a bigger circle (to vw). Moving its left edge by −(width−100)/2 vw keeps the center in place, so the edge of the arc visible on screen gradually flattens. Different circles overlap and connect for each section, such as the hero photo’s lower curve and the upper and lower curves of the navy section, gray section and black closing section. Only at 992px and above (scrub 1, GSAP default curve power1.out).

options.to: Fully grown circle width (vw), default 400 — radius and left are computed from this
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default ”top top” — the original uses ”bottom- for each section=100 bottom」·「top bottom」
options.end: ScrollTrigger end, default ‹bottom top› — ‹top+=200 top, etc.
options.up: How many parents up from the source window to take as the trigger box, default 1 (directly above)
options.min: Only at this width (px) or above, default 992
options.ease: Curve in the form ”0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94”, default power1.out

from.where: index.html .fn-hero__circle(200→400vw)·.fn-thought__circle(300→500)·.fn-service__circle(400→600)·.fn-company__circle(400→600) · shared.css .fn-aside__circle(200→400) — tweens of heroCircle·thoughtCircle·serviceCircle·companyCircle·contactCircle in the original Top·Aside
